BiblicalUsage: Pur, as a verb, means to crush, to break, to bring to nothing. God says of Zedekiah, Mine oath that he hath despised, and My covenant that he hath broken, I will recompense upon his own head, and the LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought, He maketh the devices of the people of none effect. And of David He says, My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of My lips.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that breaking runs both ways in this word: God breaks the counsel of the heathen, and men break His covenant, but His own covenant He will never break.
